import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import nnls
from treehfd import XGBTreeHFD


def _hfd_components(model, X_train, X):
    hfd = XGBTreeHFD(model)
    hfd.fit(X_train, interaction_order=2, verbose=False)
    y_main, y_order2 = hfd.predict(X, verbose=False)
    comps = {(j,): np.asarray(y_main[:, j], dtype=float) for j in range(y_main.shape[1])}
    for k, (a, b) in enumerate(hfd.interaction_list):
        a, b = int(a), int(b)
        if a > b:
            a, b = b, a
        comps[(a, b)] = np.asarray(y_order2[:, k], dtype=float)
    return float(hfd.eta0), comps


def decompose(model, X_train, X_test, alpha=1e-3):
    X_train = np.asarray(X_train, dtype=float)
    X_test = np.asarray(X_test, dtype=float)
    hfd = XGBTreeHFD(model)
    hfd.fit(X_train, interaction_order=2, verbose=False)

    def comps_of(X):
        y_main, y_order2 = hfd.predict(X, verbose=False)
        c = {(j,): np.asarray(y_main[:, j], dtype=float) for j in range(y_main.shape[1])}
        for k, (a, b) in enumerate(hfd.interaction_list):
            a, b = int(a), int(b)
            if a > b:
                a, b = b, a
            c[(a, b)] = np.asarray(y_order2[:, k], dtype=float)
        return c

    eta0 = float(hfd.eta0)
    test_c = comps_of(X_test)
    try:
        # calibration set: subsample of the training data
        n = X_train.shape[0]
        rng = np.random.RandomState(0)
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=min(n, 2000), replace=False)
        Xc = X_train[idx]
        cc = comps_of(Xc)
        keys = list(cc.keys())
        yc = model.predict(Xc).astype(float)
        # intercept column plus components; centered intercept handled as free weight
        A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xc))] + [cc[k] for k in keys])
        # non-negative ridge via augmented NNLS (intercept unpenalised-ish, nonneg weights)
        p = A.shape[1]
        sa = np.sqrt(alpha * len(Xc))
        # penalize deviation from 1 (shrink toward original decomposition)
        target = yc.copy()
        Aa = np.vstack([A, sa * np.eye(p)])
        ya = np.concatenate([target, sa * np.ones(p)])
        w, _ = nnls(Aa, ya)
        eta = eta0 * w[0]
        out = {k: w[i + 1] * test_c[k] for i, k in enumerate(keys)}
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(w)):
            raise ValueError
        return float(eta), out
    except Exception:
        return eta0, test_c


def _winsorise_components(components, lower=0.01, upper=0.99):
    """Clip every component to its own quantile range (a step the paper does not describe)."""
    clipped = {}
    for key, values in components.items():
        lo, hi = np.quantile(values, [lower, upper])
        clipped[key] = np.clip(values, lo, hi)
    return clipped
